reserves.name: SGD reserve assets in permitted financial-institution trust accounts
reserves.issuerOrObligor: CIMB, DBS, Standard Chartered Singapore, or other MAS-permitted financial institutions

reserveReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex backing review; OpenAI Codex class-level normalization
reserveReview.rationale: StraitsX states that XSGD is fully backed at all times by SGD reserve assets in segregated trust accounts at named or otherwise MAS-permitted financial institutions. The full bank-deposit reserve class is identified; the issuer does not publish current provider-level weights, so no unsupported institution allocation is recorded.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current StraitsX reserve policy and attestation index; provider-level allocation undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No direct reserve category is unidentified. The issuer does not publish the current provider allocation, account terms, or liquidity profile.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: SGD reserve assets in permitted financial-institution trust accounts
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: SGD bank deposits are external fiat reserve assets rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency; provider weights remain a custody detail.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: StraitsX names CIMB, DBS, and Standard Chartered Singapore and permits other MAS-approved institutions, but does not publish provider shares, the current complete provider set, or rehypothecation terms. The trust structure and exclusion from the issuer's unsecured-creditor estate are explicit.
